title: Gyeonggi ARES AI pig-weighing pilot cuts shipping age 5.6 days and lifts income per head 18% on six farms
summary: 2025 provincial pilot on six farms in Anseong, Pocheon and Yeoju: AI non-contact weighing cut shipping age 182.3 to 176.7 days, lifted 1+ grade share 35.3 to 37.7% and income per head 18%.
account: Gyeonggi-do Agricultural Research and Extension Services announced on 6 March 2026 (reported by The Fact, dateline Suwon, and by Joongboo Ilbo on 8 March) the results of its 2025 livestock AI pilot. A fattening-pig shipping selection system, in which AI measures pigs' weight without contact and advises the optimal shipping date, was introduced on six farms in Anseong, Pocheon and Yeoju: shipping age fell from 182.3 to 176.7 days (5.6 days), the share shipped at grade 1+ rose from 35.3% to 37.7% (2.4 percentage points) and income per head rose from 100,000 to 118,000 won (18%). A sow farrowing management system using ICT equipment for real-time monitoring, introduced on Pocheon farms, cut the sow accident rate (mastitis, fever, loss of appetite, crushing of piglets) from 3.1% to 2.7% and raised piglets shipped per sow per year from 18.3 to 19.2 (4.9%), with real-time alerts reducing the need to stay in the barn. Lee Jun-bae, head of the agency's technology dissemination division, said the results confirmed AI as a way to raise productivity and income, and the agency plans to extend the weighing system to Yeoncheon in 2026. The vendor of the systems is not named. Listed in the OECD AI Incidents Monitor (2026-03-05-1ac3).
purpose: Measure fattening pigs' weight without contact using AI and advise the optimal shipping date; monitor sows in real time around farrowing.
system: Fattening-pig shipping selection system (AI non-contact weighing) and sow farrowing management system (ICT monitoring)
developer: Not named in the fetched sources
deployer: Gyeonggi-do Agricultural Research and Extension Services with six pig farms in Anseong, Pocheon and Yeoju (weighing) and Pocheon farms (sow system)
location: Anseong, Pocheon and Yeoju, South Korea
taxonomy_note: Benefit created on before/after production figures published by the deploying public body and reported by two newspapers with a named official; no control group or method is described, and the sow system is described as ICT monitoring rather than AI, so only the weighing system is clearly AI. Listed in the OECD AI Incidents Monitor; the parent workflow classed it as an aggregate benefit.

ratings.reason: Shipping age 182.3 to 176.7 days, grade 1+ share 35.3% to 37.7%, income per head 100,000 to 118,000 won (18%) on six farms; sow accidents 3.1% to 2.7% and piglets per sow per year 18.3 to 19.2 on Pocheon farms, per the agency's own before/after figures.
Reduced need for farmers to stay in the barn is mentioned but not measured.

ai_role.statement: The AI's contribution is the weight estimate and shipping-date advice; the production gains are the agency's uncontrolled before/after comparisons. The deployer is a public body that reports its own pilot; the developer is not named. Two independent newspapers carried the release with a named official.
